value.rationale: The exact all-even-diameter conditional pair law provides a motivated local counterpart to global even-diameter metric concentration, including an explicit exponential decay constant unavailable from the global 0-1 law. The universal finite-size reversal between equally dominant upper endpoint distances is a structural distinction, not an arbitrary finite table or a routine fixed-diameter substitution. A deterministic all-distance finite-sum formula makes the law usable for every fixed diameter and base size; h=2 has a sharp unique crossover.
